card.name: Linking words around PCI and antiplatelet drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as after, of, the and strains, placed right before a procedure or drug name in antiplatelet or anticoagulant labeling, especially around PCI and clopidogrel.

modes.label: After the procedure
modes.description: The word after (or the) following a statement about anticoagulation or infusion in PCI.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like strains or receiving that precede a specific name or term.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts beginning with p or trans, with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words just before a procedure or drug name, mostly in heart-procedure blood thinner labels.
